comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Apart from being a one-time Memorial Album reward, this can apparently also be found in Famagusta Church through the use of Search. This is good, since it's also part of a Memorial Album as well.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=2240

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: For what it's worth, I found out this is one of the items we can give to the shopkeeper in Ternate to improve the town status. I didn't stay to see which of the three ratings it increases and by how much (I'm guessing it adds to culture).

comments.author: Sophia
comments.body: Found one Search R9 behind altar in Famagusta church, it went into my Memorial Album, while looking for a Galileo-style telescope
